versos.grego: Ἐν ἐκείνῳ τῷ καιρῷ ἤκουσεν Ἡρῴδης ὁ τετραάρχης τὴν ἀκοὴν Ἰησοῦ,

controles.web: At that time, Herod the tetrarch heard the report concerning Jesus,
controles.kjv: At that time Herod the tetrarch heard of the fame of Jesus,
controles.livre: Naquele tempo Herodes, o tetrarca, ouviu relato a respeito de Jesus,

versos.grego: καὶ εἶπεν τοῖς παισὶν αὐτοῦ Οὗτός ἐστιν Ἰωάνης ὁ Βαπτιστής· αὐτὸς ἠγέρθη ἀπὸ τῶν νεκρῶν, καὶ διὰ τοῦτο αἱ δυνάμεις ἐνεργοῦσιν ἐν αὐτῷ.

controles.web: and said to his servants, “This is John the Baptizer. He is risen from the dead. That is why these powers work in him.”
controles.kjv: And said unto his servants, This is John the Baptist; he is risen from the dead; and therefore mighty works do shew forth themselves in him.
controles.livre: e disse aos seus servos: Este é João Batista; ele ressuscitou dos mortos, e por isso os milagres operam nele.

versos.grego: Ὁ γὰρ Ἡρῴδης κρατήσας τὸν Ἰωάνην ἔδησεν καὶ ἐν φυλακῇ ἀπέθετο διὰ Ἡρῳδιάδα τὴν γυναῖκα Φιλίππου τοῦ ἀδελφοῦ αὐτοῦ·

controles.web: For Herod had laid hold of John, and bound him, and put him in prison for the sake of Herodias, his brother Philip’s wife.
controles.kjv: For Herod had laid hold on John, and bound him, and put him in prison for Herodias’ sake, his brother Philip’s wife.
controles.livre: Porque Herodes havia prendido a João, acorrentado-o,  e posto na prisão, por causa de Herodias, mulher do seu irmão Filipe;

versos.grego: ἔλεγεν γὰρ ὁ Ἰωάνης αὐτῷ Οὐκ ἔξεστίν σοι ἔχειν αὐτήν.

controles.web: For John said to him, “It is not lawful for you to have her.”
controles.kjv: For John said unto him, It is not lawful for thee to have her.
controles.livre: pois João lhe dizia: Não te lícito que a tenhas.

versos.grego: καὶ θέλων αὐτὸν ἀποκτεῖναι ἐφοβήθη τὸν ὄχλον, ὅτι ὡς προφήτην αὐτὸν εἶχον.

controles.web: When he would have put him to death, he feared the multitude, because they counted him as a prophet.
controles.kjv: And when he would have put him to death, he feared the multitude, because they counted him as a prophet.
controles.livre: Herodes queria matá-lo, mas tinha medo do povo, pois o consideravam profeta.

versos.grego: γενεσίοις δὲ γενομένοις τοῦ Ἡρῴδου ὠρχήσατο ἡ θυγάτηρ τῆς Ἡρῳδιάδος ἐν τῷ μέσῳ καὶ ἤρεσεν τῷ Ἡρῴδῃ,

controles.web: But when Herod’s birthday came, the daughter of Herodias danced among them and pleased Herod.
controles.kjv: But when Herod’s birthday was kept, the daughter of Herodias danced before them, and pleased Herod.
controles.livre: Porém, quando chegou o aniversário de Herodes, a filha de Herodias dançou no meio das pessoas ,e agradou a Herodes.

versos.grego: ὅθεν μεθ’ ὅρκου ὡμολόγησεν αὐτῇ δοῦναι ὃ ἐὰν αἰτήσηται.

controles.web: Whereupon he promised with an oath to give her whatever she should ask.
controles.kjv: Whereupon he promised with an oath to give her whatsoever she would ask.
controles.livre: Por isso prometeu a ela dar tudo o que pedisse.

versos.grego: ἡ δὲ προβιβασθεῖσα ὑπὸ τῆς μητρὸς αὐτῆς Δός μοι, φησίν, ὧδε ἐπὶ πίνακι τὴν κεφαλὴν Ἰωάνου τοῦ Βαπτιστοῦ.

controles.web: She, being prompted by her mother, said, “Give me here on a platter the head of John the Baptizer.”
controles.kjv: And she, being before instructed of her mother, said, Give me here John Baptist’s head in a charger.
controles.livre: E ela, tendo sido induzida por sua mãe, disse: Dá-me aqui num prato a cabeça de João Batista.

versos.grego: καὶ λυπηθεὶς ὁ βασιλεὺς διὰ τοὺς ὅρκους καὶ τοὺς συνανακειμένους ἐκέλευσεν δοθῆναι,

controles.web: The king was grieved, but for the sake of his oaths, and of those who sat at the table with him, he commanded it to be given,
controles.kjv: And the king was sorry: nevertheless for the oath’s sake, and them which sat with him at meat, he commanded it to be given her.
controles.livre: E o rei se entristeceu; mas devido ao juramento, e aos que estavam presentes, ordenou que isso fosse concedido.

versos.grego: καὶ πέμψας ἀπεκεφάλισεν Ἰωάνην ἐν τῇ φυλακῇ.

controles.web: and he sent and beheaded John in the prison.
controles.kjv: And he sent, and beheaded John in the prison.
controles.livre: Então mandou degolarem João na prisão.

versos.grego: καὶ ἠνέχθη ἡ κεφαλὴ αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ πίνακι καὶ ἐδόθη τῷ κορασίῳ, καὶ ἤνεγκεν τῇ μητρὶ αὐτῆς.

controles.web: His head was brought on a platter, and given to the young lady: and she brought it to her mother.
controles.kjv: And his head was brought in a charger, and given to the damsel: and she brought it to her mother.
controles.livre: Sua cabeça foi trazida num prato, e dada à garota, e ela a levou à sua mãe.

versos.grego: καὶ προσελθόντες οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ ἦραν τὸ πτῶμα καὶ ἔθαψαν αὐτόν, καὶ ἐλθόντες ἀπήγγειλαν τῷ Ἰησοῦ.

controles.web: His disciples came, and took the body, and buried it; and they went and told Jesus.
controles.kjv: And his disciples came, and took up the body, and buried it, and went and told Jesus.
controles.livre: E seus discípulos vieram, tomaram o corpo, e o enterraram; e foram avisar a Jesus.

versos.grego: Ἀκούσας δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἀνεχώρησεν ἐκεῖθεν ἐν πλοίῳ εἰς ἔρημον τόπον κατ’ ἰδίαν· καὶ ἀκούσαντες οἱ ὄχλοι ἠκολούθησαν αὐτῷ πεζῇ ἀπὸ τῶν πόλεων.

controles.web: Now when Jesus heard this, he withdrew from there in a boat, to a deserted place apart. When the multitudes heard it, they followed him on foot from the cities.
controles.kjv: When Jesus heard of it, he departed thence by ship into a desert place apart: and when the people had heard thereof, they followed him on foot out of the cities.
controles.livre: Depois de Jesus ouvir, retirou-se dali num barco, a um lugar deserto, sozinho; mas assim que as multidões ouviram acerca disso, seguiram-no a pé das cidades.

versos.grego: Καὶ ἐξελθὼν εἶδεν πολὺν ὄχλον, καὶ ἐσπλαγχνίσθη ἐπ’ αὐτοῖς καὶ ἐθεράπευσεν τοὺς ἀρρώστους αὐτῶν.

controles.web: Jesus went out, and he saw a great multitude. He had compassion on them, and healed their sick.
controles.kjv: And Jesus went forth, and saw a great multitude, and was moved with compassion toward them, and he healed their sick.
controles.livre: Quando Jesus saiu, viu uma grande multidão. Ele se compadeceu deles, e curou dentre eles os enfermos.

versos.grego: ὀψίας δὲ γενομένης προσῆλθον αὐτῷ οἱ μαθηταὶ λέγοντες Ἔρημός ἐστιν ὁ τόπος καὶ ἡ ὥρα ἤδη παρῆλθεν· ἀπόλυσον οὖν τοὺς ὄχλους, ἵνα ἀπελθόντες εἰς τὰς κώμας ἀγοράσωσιν ἑαυτοῖς βρώματα.

controles.web: When evening had come, his disciples came to him, saying, “This place is deserted, and the hour is already late. Send the multitudes away, that they may go into the villages, and buy themselves food.”
controles.kjv: And when it was evening, his disciples came to him, saying, This is a desert place, and the time is now past; send the multitude away, that they may go into the villages, and buy themselves victuals.
controles.livre: E chegando o entardecer, os discípulos se aproximaram dele, e disseram: O lugar é deserto, e já é tarde.  Despede as multidões, para irem às aldeias, e comprarem para si de comer.

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Οὐ χρείαν ἔχουσιν ἀπελθεῖν· δότε αὐτοῖς ὑμεῖς φαγεῖν.

controles.web: But Jesus said to them, “They don’t need to go away. You give them something to eat.”
controles.kjv: But Jesus said unto them, They need not depart; give ye them to eat.
controles.livre: Mas Jesus lhes respondeu: Eles não precisam ir. Vós mesmos, dai-lhes de comer.

versos.grego: οἱ δὲ λέγουσιν αὐτῷ Οὐκ ἔχομεν ὧδε εἰ μὴ πέντε ἄρτους καὶ δύο ἰχθύας.

controles.web: They told him, “We only have here five loaves and two fish.”
controles.kjv: And they say unto him, We have here but five loaves, and two fishes.
controles.livre: E eles lhe disseram: Nada temos aqui além de cinco pães e dois peixes.

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ εἶπεν· Φέρετέ μοι ὧδε αὐτούς.

controles.web: He said, “Bring them here to me.”
controles.kjv: He said, Bring them hither to me.
controles.livre: Então disse: Trazei-os aqui a mim.

versos.grego: καὶ κελεύσας τοὺς ὄχλους ἀνακλιθῆναι ἐπὶ τοῦ χόρτου, λαβὼν τοὺς πέντε ἄρτους καὶ τοὺς δύο ἰχθύας, ἀναβλέψας εἰς τὸν οὐρανὸν εὐλόγησεν, καὶ κλάσας ἔδωκεν τοῖς μαθηταῖς τοὺς ἄρτους, οἱ δὲ μαθηταὶ τοῖς ὄχλοις.

controles.web: He commanded the multitudes to sit down on the grass; and he took the five loaves and the two fish, and looking up to heaven, he blessed, broke and gave the loaves to the disciples, and the disciples gave to the multitudes.
controles.kjv: And he commanded the multitude to sit down on the grass, and took the five loaves, and the two fishes, and looking up to heaven, he blessed, and brake, and gave the loaves to his disciples, and the disciples to the multitude.
controles.livre: Ele mandou às multidões que se sentassem sobre a grama. Então tomou os cinco pães e os dois peixes, levantou os olhos ao céu, e os abençoou. Em seguida partiu os pães, deu-os aos discípulos, e os discípulos às multidões.

versos.grego: καὶ ἔφαγον πάντες καὶ ἐχορτάσθησαν, καὶ ἦραν τὸ περισσεῦον τῶν κλασμάτων δώδεκα κοφίνους πλήρεις.

controles.web: They all ate, and were filled. They took up twelve baskets full of that which remained left over from the broken pieces.
controles.kjv: And they did all eat, and were filled: and they took up of the fragments that remained twelve baskets full.
controles.livre: E todos comeram, e se fartaram. E do que sobrou dos pedaços levantaram doze cestos cheios.

versos.grego: οἱ δὲ ἐσθίοντες ἦσαν ἄνδρες ὡσεὶ πεντακισχίλιοι χωρὶς γυναικῶν καὶ παιδίων.

controles.web: Those who ate were about five thousand men, besides women and children.
controles.kjv: And they that had eaten were about five thousand men, beside women and children.
controles.livre: E os que comeram foram quase cinco mil homens, sem contar as mulheres e as crianças.

versos.grego: Καὶ εὐθέως ἠνάγκασεν τοὺς μαθητὰς ἐμβῆναι εἰς τὸ πλοῖον καὶ προάγειν αὐτὸν εἰς τὸ πέραν, ἕως οὗ ἀπολύσῃ τοὺς ὄχλους.

controles.web: Immediately Jesus made the disciples get into the boat, and to go ahead of him to the other side, while he sent the multitudes away.
controles.kjv: And straightway Jesus constrained his disciples to get into a ship, and to go before him unto the other side, while he sent the multitudes away.
controles.livre: E logo Jesus mandou os discípulos entrarem no barco, e que fossem adiante dele para a outra margem, enquanto ele despedia as multidões.

versos.grego: καὶ ἀπολύσας τοὺς ὄχλους ἀνέβη εἰς τὸ ὄρος κατ’ ἰδίαν προσεύξασθαι. ὀψίας δὲ γενομένης μόνος ἦν ἐκεῖ.

controles.web: After he had sent the multitudes away, he went up into the mountain by himself to pray. When evening had come, he was there alone.
controles.kjv: And when he had sent the multitudes away, he went up into a mountain apart to pray: and when the evening was come, he was there alone.
controles.livre: Depois de despedir as multidões, subiu ao monte, à parte, para orar. Tendo chegado a noite, ele estava ali sozinho.

versos.grego: τὸ δὲ πλοῖον ἤδη σταδίους πολλοὺς ἀπὸ τῆς γῆς ἀπεῖχεν, βασανιζόμενον ὑπὸ τῶν κυμάτων, ἦν γὰρ ἐναντίος ὁ ἄνεμος.

controles.web: But the boat was now in the middle of the sea, distressed by the waves, for the wind was contrary.
controles.kjv: But the ship was now in the midst of the sea, tossed with waves: for the wind was contrary.
controles.livre: E o barco já estava a vários estádios de distância da terra, atormentado pelas ondas, porque o vento era contrário.

versos.grego: τετάρτῃ δὲ φυλακῇ τῆς νυκτὸς ἦλθεν πρὸς αὐτοὺς περιπατῶν ἐπὶ τὴν θάλασσαν.

controles.web: In the fourth watch of the night, Jesus came to them, walking on the sea.
controles.kjv: And in the fourth watch of the night Jesus went unto them, walking on the sea.
controles.livre: Mas à quarta vigília  da noite Jesus foi até eles, andando sobre o mar.

versos.grego: οἱ δὲ μαθηταὶ ἰδόντες αὐτὸν ἐπὶ τῆς θαλάσσης περιπατοῦντα ἐταράχθησαν λέγοντες ὅτι Φάντασμά ἐστιν, καὶ ἀπὸ τοῦ φόβου ἔκραξαν.

controles.web: When the disciples saw him walking on the sea, they were troubled, saying, “It’s a ghost!” and they cried out for fear.
controles.kjv: And when the disciples saw him walking on the sea, they were troubled, saying, It is a spirit; and they cried out for fear.
controles.livre: Quando os discípulos o viram andar sobre o mar, apavoraram-se, dizendo: É um fantasma! E gritaram de medo.

versos.grego: εὐθὺς δὲ ἐλάλησεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς αὐτοῖς λέγων Θαρσεῖτε, ἐγώ εἰμι· μὴ φοβεῖσθε.

controles.web: But immediately Jesus spoke to them, saying “Cheer up! It is I! Don’t be afraid.”
controles.kjv: But straightway Jesus spake unto them, saying, Be of good cheer; it is I; be not afraid.
controles.livre: Mas Jesus logo lhes falou, dizendo: Tende coragem! Sou eu, não tenhais medo.

versos.grego: ἀποκριθεὶς δὲ αὐτῷ ὁ Πέτρος εἶπεν Κύριε, εἰ σὺ εἶ, κέλευσόν με ἐλθεῖν πρὸς σὲ ἐπὶ τὰ ὕδατα.

controles.web: Peter answered him and said, “Lord, if it is you, command me to come to you on the waters.”
controles.kjv: And Peter answered him and said, Lord, if it be thou, bid me come unto thee on the water.
controles.livre: E Pedro lhe respondeu, dizendo: Senhor, se és tu, manda-me vir a ti sobre as águas.

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ εἶπεν Ἐλθέ. καὶ καταβὰς ἀπὸ τοῦ πλοίου Πέτρος περιεπάτησεν ἐπὶ τὰ ὕδατα καὶ ἦλθεν πρὸς τὸν Ἰησοῦν.

controles.web: He said, “Come!”   Peter stepped down from the boat, and walked on the waters to come to Jesus.
controles.kjv: And he said, Come. And when Peter was come down out of the ship, he walked on the water, to go to Jesus.
controles.livre: E ele disse: Vem. Então Pedro desceu do barco e andou sobre as águas, e foi em direção a Jesus.

versos.grego: βλέπων δὲ τὸν ἄνεμον ἐφοβήθη, καὶ ἀρξάμενος καταποντίζεσθαι ἔκραξεν λέγων Κύριε, σῶσόν με.

controles.web: But when he saw that the wind was strong, he was afraid, and beginning to sink, he cried out, saying, “Lord, save me!”
controles.kjv: But when he saw the wind boisterous, he was afraid; and beginning to sink, he cried, saying, Lord, save me.
controles.livre: Mas quando viu o vento, teve medo; e começando a afundar, gritou: Senhor, salva-me!

versos.grego: εὐθέως δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἐκτείνας τὴν χεῖρα ἐπελάβετο αὐτοῦ καὶ λέγει αὐτῷ Ὀλιγόπιστε, εἰς τί ἐδίστασας;

controles.web: Immediately Jesus stretched out his hand, took hold of him, and said to him, “You of little faith, why did you doubt?”
controles.kjv: And immediately Jesus stretched forth his hand, and caught him, and said unto him, O thou of little faith, wherefore didst thou doubt?
controles.livre: Imediatamente Jesus estendeu a mão, segurou-o, e disse-lhe: Homem de pouca fé, por que duvidaste?

versos.grego: καὶ ἀναβάντων αὐτῶν εἰς τὸ πλοῖον ἐκόπασεν ὁ ἄνεμος.

controles.web: When they got up into the boat, the wind ceased.
controles.kjv: And when they were come into the ship, the wind ceased.
controles.livre: E quando subiram no barco, o vento se aquietou.

versos.grego: οἱ δὲ ἐν τῷ πλοίῳ προσεκύνησαν αὐτῷ λέγοντες Ἀληθῶς Θεοῦ Υἱὸς εἶ.

controles.web: Those who were in the boat came and worshiped him, saying, “You are truly the Son of God!”
controles.kjv: Then they that were in the ship came and worshipped him, saying, Of a truth thou art the Son of God.
controles.livre: Então os que estavam no barco vieram e o adoraram, dizendo: Verdadeiramente tu és o Filho de Deus.

versos.grego: Καὶ διαπεράσαντες ἦλθον ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν εἰς Γεννησαρέτ.

controles.web: When they had crossed over, they came to the land of Gennesaret.
controles.kjv: And when they were gone over, they came into the land of Gennesaret.
controles.livre: E havendo passado para a outra margem, chegaram à terra de Genesaré.

versos.grego: καὶ ἐπιγνόντες αὐτὸν οἱ ἄνδρες τοῦ τόπου ἐκείνου ἀπέστειλαν εἰς ὅλην τὴν περίχωρον ἐκείνην, καὶ προσήνεγκαν αὐτῷ πάντας τοὺς κακῶς ἔχοντας,

controles.web: When the people of that place recognized him, they sent into all that surrounding region, and brought to him all who were sick,
controles.kjv: And when the men of that place had knowledge of him, they sent out into all that country round about, and brought unto him all that were diseased;
controles.livre: E quando os homens daquele lugar o reconheceram, deram aviso por toda aquela região ao redor, e lhe trouxeram todos os que estavam enfermos.

versos.grego: καὶ παρεκάλουν αὐτὸν ἵνα μόνον ἅψωνται τοῦ κρασπέδου τοῦ ἱματίου αὐτοῦ· καὶ ὅσοι ἥψαντο διεσώθησαν.

controles.web: and they begged him that they might just touch the fringe of his garment. As many as touched it were made whole.
controles.kjv: And besought him that they might only touch the hem of his garment: and as many as touched were made perfectly whole.
controles.livre: E rogavam-lhe que tão somente tocassem a borda  de sua roupa;  e todos os que tocavam ficaram curados.
